ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Vocal duets sound appealing given my interest in polished vocal performances on A Musical Affair and Stages.
ItemID: NA; Title: It's Entertainment; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: This fits the theatrical vocal entertainment I enjoy in Stages and Lead With Your Heart.
ItemID: NA; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I enjoy some Christmas music, but I am looking for everyday listening right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best Of; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this compilation matches my taste.
ItemID: NA; Title: Someday at Christmas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My past Christmas listening does not make another holiday album a priority right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Classic Christmas Album; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would save this for a holiday listening mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Born Again: Miracles Edition; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me little reason to expect the orchestral or theatrical vocals I currently want.
ItemID: NA; Title: Cinema; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Film-themed vocal music strongly appeals to my interest in soundtracks and the grand performances on Amor & Pasion.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wicked: 2003 Original Broadway Cast; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Stages makes me interested in exploring a full Broadway cast recording with expressive singing.
ItemID: NA; Title: The World in My Mind; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not recognize enough about this album to choose it over the clearer vocal and soundtrack matches.
